extension.summary: Cinematic 1080p skin inspired by the Apple TV home layout.
extension.description: A dark, minimal 1080p Kodi skin built around a translucent top menu, large poster shelves, and quiet focus motion. Independent layout framework — not affiliated with Apple.
extension.disclaimer: Independent fan skin. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Apple Inc.
